title: Popular AI leaderboard Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1B valuation in 10 months | TechCrunch
summary: Arena , which originated in 2023 as a research project at UC Berkeley that crowdsourced rankings of AI models, has raised a $200 million Series B round at a $3.1 billion valuation, it said on Thursday.
